kpis.sub: ILLUMINA (ILMN) FALLS 18.6% TO $235.99 ON OCT 30 DESPITE A Q3 BEAT AND RAISED GUIDANCE
kpis.label: ILMN closed at $235.99 on Oct 30 (-18.64% on the day; $269.42 on Oct 23, so -12.4% on the week), after Q3 revenue of $1.13B (+4.2%) and non-GAAP EPS of $1.44 ex tariff refunds versus $1.36 consensus. FY26 guidance was raised (revenue $4.64-4.66B, EPS $5.40-5.45). Coverage blamed tariffs and AI worries after a ~157% run-up. Pre-earnings average target was $248.90 (21 analysts, Hold); JPMorgan cut to $300 from $320, Evercore to $275 from $290, Stifel raised to $300.

kpis.sub: TEMPUS AI (TEM) CLOSES $72.22 ON OCT 30 (-7.2% ON THE DAY, +6.8% ON THE WEEK); Q3 RESULTS DUE NOV 2 BEFORE THE OPEN
kpis.label: TEM closed at $72.22 on Oct 30 (-7.22%; $77.84 the day before, $67.62 on Oct 23), market cap $13.03B, $75.06 average target (20 analysts, Buy), after-hours $70.10. TTM revenue $1.43B (+50%), net loss ~$254M. IVDR certification for its xR RNA sequencing assay (Oct 26). ARK bought about $4.4M of TEM on Oct 30. Q3 results were not available when this page was built.

kpis.sub: ELI LILLY Q3 REVENUE ~$24.4B (+39%); FY26 GUIDE RAISED TO $91-92B; SHARES ABOUT +6% ON THE REPORT
kpis.label: Lilly's Q3 revenue was about $24.4B (+39%; volume +53%, realized prices -15%), GAAP EPS $7.22, and FY26 revenue guidance rose to $91-92B from $85-87B. About $900M of Q3 revenue was one-time (Jardiance milestones and rebate adjustments), and full-year EPS guidance slipped on acquired IPR&D charges (AtaiBeckley, Curevo; $4.57/share). Shares were up about 6% at midday on the report. No new AI deal this week; last close seen: $1,279.14 on Oct 26.

kpis.sub: ARKG CLOSES $48.72 ON OCT 26 (+1.2%); 35 HOLDINGS, TOP-10 ~58% (OCT 21); 1-YEAR RETURN ~52.8%
kpis.label: ARKG closed at $48.72 on Oct 26 (latest close found), with 35 holdings, a 0.75% expense ratio, AUM $2.02B, a trailing 1-year total return of about 52.8% and roughly 8% a year since its Oct 31, 2014 inception (derived). private_watchlist.name: Isomorphic Labs
private_watchlist.note: No fresh update found this week beyond Bloomberg's Oct 8 report of preliminary talks at a valuation of at least $40B (possibly up to $50B); no deal is final. It closed a $2.1B Series B in May 2026 and still targets first trials by year-end 2026 for ISM8969.

private_watchlist.name: Insilico Medicine
private_watchlist.note: ESMO 2026 data for pan-TEAD inhibitor ISM6331: 40% ORR at 130 mg in heavily pretreated mesothelioma (company release, small early-phase cohort). Rentosertib's Phase III (GENESIS-IPF) remains underway with approval realistically 2029-2030. Public on HKEX since Dec 2025.

private_watchlist.name: Xaira Therapeutics
private_watchlist.note: No fresh update found this week. The company continues hiring out its business-development function to line up partnerships that supply preclinical disease-area data rather than capital — it says the $1.3B already raised covers its near-term needs — but no partner has been named and no trial has started.

private_watchlist.name: NewLimit
private_watchlist.note: No fresh update found this week. Still the year's largest single disclosed longevity round (~71% of 2026's disclosed longevity funding through August); its first candidate medicine remains in large-scale manufacturing with clinical entry targeted as early as 2027.

bear_case.title: Biology still fails in the clinic, and the clock hasn't moved
bear_case.description: Zero AI-discovered drugs have reached full FDA approval out of 200+ in clinical development. Insilico's lead investigator puts rentosertib's approval at 2029-2030. Intellia's lonvo-z (PDUFA Mar 10, 2027) is gene editing rather than AI discovery; Barclays is Underweight ($8) with NTLA near $11.

bear_case.title: Even good prints can be sold: Illumina -18.6% on a beat-and-raise
bear_case.description: ILMN beat EPS and raised guidance yet fell 18.64% to $235.99 on Oct 30 after a ~157% run-up, on tariff and AI worries. Revenue growth is ~4%, so the multiple, not the quarter, was the issue. Tempus (+6.8% on the week, -7.2% Friday) enters its Nov 2 print with similar positioning.

bear_case.title: Platform value is unproven and dilution is the funding model
bear_case.description: Recursion raised $200M at $3.25 (Oct 15) and trades at $3.80. Generate (~$12.4 vs $16 IPO) and Eikon ($5.54 vs $18, -23.7% in a day on ESMO data) show IPO-window names fading without an approved drug.

bear_case.title: Diagnostics litigation and sub-scale proteomics
bear_case.description: Guardant's PTAB challenge to a core TwinStrand patent was rejected (~Oct 14) and the judgment appeal is open. Quantum-Si ($1.40 on Oct 23, last quote available) has TTM revenue of $1.61M (-53%) and no launch until Q2 2027.

bear_case.title: Rate and macro sensitivity: tech sell-offs spill into biotech
bear_case.description: NVIDIA fell 4.2% on Oct 30 in a broad tech sell-off. XBI was $150.47 on Oct 26, below its $169.89 52-week high; a hawkish rates move or failed readout reverses rallies like this. Lilly's strong quarter included ~15% price erosion, a reminder that policy and pricing risk sits in the large caps too.
